title: GPY lower bounds and distances between Gaussian primes
exact_target: Can the Goldston--Pintz--Y\i ld\i r\i m method produce an asymptotic count of primes with specified spacing, or at least a lower bound of the correct order? The latter asks for a positive proportion of the admissible tuples under consideration to contain at least two primes. A second question asks whether the method can be adapted to obtain small distances between Gaussian primes.
